comment: She was a good teacher for our class, but I was not an English major, so it was a difficult class for me. The reads were pretty good for the most part as well (1984) ect. The class was mostly discussion-based, talking about the reading/ review that we did.  If you are good at english than this is the class for you.
the kindest and most accessible prof that I have ever had at UR

She's a great teacher and I enjoyed her classes. Her readings were easy to do but there was a fair amount that is to be expected in an English class. She cares a lot about effort and participation. She is a tough grader though.
She is very helpful and sweet and you should be fine as long as you engage in class and try your best!

Such a kind and intelligent professor. I've taken two classes with her now and adored both of them, I hope to take more. Her class, especially FYS are super reading heavy, her YA class we were reading a new book every other week, but they were YA and not very challenging. Love her, take her class!!

Outka is wonderful and super kind. She is extremely helpful with papers and bouncing ideas off for topics. Class was primarily discussion on student papers which helped develop my close reading skills. She is super understanding and supportive. You will improve you reading analysis and essay writing skills.

Dr. Outka is clearly passionate about what she does and she is a well-respected professor at UR. I did enjoy her class along with the books and movies that we read/watched, how this is a class that expects A LOT. Only two papers, 5 short response papers, and a final but TONS of homework. A good class to take if you want to challenge yourself.
she's very kind and cool. Her classes are amazingly interesting even if you are not an english major.

Dr. Outka is by far my favorite professor!!! This fys is time-consuming but worth spending time, and Dr. Outka is really approachable and accessible outside the class, she gives useful feedbacks and really wants us to improve and to learn. It's hard to find a professor that cares you and your life so much! I will definitely take her class again!

Dr. Outka is AMAZING!!! Truly cares about her students like they are her own kids and will work hard to make sure you do well in her class. Women in Modern Lit is super interesting and the books are great and inspirational. She's very clear about expectations but make sure to READ INSTRUCTIONS carefully! Great prof great class!

Dr. Outka is a really good professor. I've learned a lot from her Women in Modern Literature. It's been a great pleasure to take her class. She gives me great feedback and advising throughout the semester. She also listens to our mid-term evaluation, and improves her class all the time. Good for her! I really recommend taking one of her classes.

Dr. Outka is really lovely. She leads great discussions in class and her lecturing is really helpful when she does it. Her book choice is super interesting as well - would definitely recommend her for anyone looking to be in an English class!

Dr. Outka provides very very clear guidelines and criteria for what she is looking for in papers. It's an English class, so be prepared for reading. Dr. Outka has a very interesting choice of books, and I enjoyed reading each one of them. She is very accessible outside of class and wants you to succeed! All around great professor!

Most relatable and best professor I have had the pleasure of taking. Tough grader, but going to her office hours definitely helps your grade in terms of getting feedback. Very understanding and intelligent person. Cannot recommend highly enough.

I am a terrible writer and I hate reading. I took this class for the gen ed. and I struggled with writing the papers, but Dr. Outka made it a lot easier. She's very helpful and gives great feedback. I entered the class thinking I'd leave with a C+ or B-, and I'm leaving with a B+ and I'm happy with that.

Favorite professor I've taken at UR so far. You can tell the passion she has for some of these novels and it really shows in her teaching. WHen it comes to essays, she's tough. But go to office hours! Her advice improved really helped and I got an A-. Really great class and professor. If you do the reading and make an effort, it's worth your while.

I love Dr. Outka. She is such a sweetheart, and she truly loves all of her students. She is also a great teacher; I learned so much about writing and thinking critically from taking her class. She can be a tough grader, and you absolutely have to do the reading, but she is also approachable and friendly if you are struggling.

Dr. Outka is REALLY knowledgable. She's taught me so much about writing. She gave my FYS class a great writing consultant who I think I might even use throughout the 4 years I'm here. Not laid back and easy, but if you're willing to learn and put forth the effort, I would recommend her 100%.

Dr. Outka is a fantastic professor who is passionate, helpful, smart and funny. She was willing to meet with us all whenever needed and she pushed me to be a better writer. I can say, without question, that she is one of the best professors I have ever had. Take her class. You will meet an amazing person and will become a better English student.

I actually had Dr. Outka for 2 classes last semester, and they were my two favorites! She's super helpful and outrageously knowledgeable, not impossible to get an A but she will make you work for it. Probably my favorite teacher on the English faculty, I recommend her without hesitation

By far my favorite teacher of last year.  I loved her so much, I signed up for another one of her classes this year!  She is incredibly passionate about English and also incredibly qualified.  However, it is hard to get an A in the class, but she is ALWAYS there to help you with your essays. Love her!
Wonderful.  Such a nice woman and so smart and funny.  Take her!  Just be warned, you will work hard.
Extremely hard, impossible to get an A.

By far the best professor I've ever had.  I can't speak highly enough about her--she loves what she teaches and she teaches it incredibly well.  If you have an opportunity, or need to fill out an English elective, you won't go wrong by taking a course with her.

Outka is truly a remarkable professor. I took her Modern Novel class and reading 40 pages for each class soon became one of my favorite things to do. She chooses her readings very carefully and class discussion was always interesting. She's a fair grader so do your reading and you will get a good grade and  may even find yourself having fun.

Professor Outka is amazing. She's extremely intelligent and compassionate. Her writing tips are great and she is extremely helpful in and out of class. Do the reading or its not worth going to class. She even convinced a girl to switch her major to English! TAKE HER CLASS!
